Name: Coffee Shoppe
Author: Tanpoponoko
Description:
Comes with one new machine, 13 new artisan goods, and 9 new recipes.



-----PLEASE CHECK THE REQUIRED MODS-----


[b]Installation:[/b]
- Drag the Espresso Machine folder (inside the CFR folder) into the machines folder in Custom Farming Redux in your mods
- Drag the other Espresso Machine folder (inside the Json Assets folder) into the content packs folder in Json Assets in your mods

[b]Espresso Machine Recipes:[/b]

5 coffee beans +....

Café latte – Large milk + sugar
Café mocha – Chocolate syrup
Cappuccino - Goat milk + Sugar
Cafe Americano – Coffee
Macchiato – Small milk
Peppermint Mocha –Mint + Chocolate
Affogato – Vanilla ice cream
Salted caramel mocha – Caramel + salt + sugar
Maple macchiato – Maple syrup
Vanilla latte – Vanilla
Toasted coconut mocha – Coconut
Hot Irish coffee – Whiskey

[b]New Recipes:
[/b]Biscotti
Croissant
Hot Cocoa
Petit Fours
Cake Pops
Pumpkin Scone
Scone
Pound Cake
Breakfast Sandwich[b]

[/b]
